note: The record of which containment probes have actually run, kept in the repository rather than
in a terminal that has scrolled away. Ticket 26: probe 6 needs a credential, skipped from the
day it was written, printed its reason on every run, and behind that skip sat a real defect
(ticket 27) and a fictional one that cost most of a day. A printed reason was not enough,
because a skip that has never once completed and a skip taken this morning read identically.
So the fact is committed. "lastCompleted": null means nobody, on any machine, has ever run
this probe end to end — which is a property of the repository and visible in review, not a
property of whoever happens to be running the suite. Only a real run changes it:
packages/harness/src/containment.probe.test.ts writes this file after the last assertion
passes, and there is no way to fill it in by editing prose.
This file is under packages/harness/**, which sandbox-policy.json denies the agent write
access to (ADR-0002). The agent cannot forge an attestation for a probe about the agent.
A run that updates it leaves a dirty working tree on purpose. Commit the change: it is the
evidence.  bun run probe  is the command that produces one.
